tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Fetch the full ticket record: subject, body, submitter email, timestamps. Call this first.

tools.name: lookup_customer_info
tools.description: Identify the customer account from the submitter's email (or a customer_id). Returns customer_id, name, plan tier, and SSO status. Use this to find out who filed the ticket.

tools.name: fetch_customer_details
tools.description: Account details for a known customer_id: MRR, signup date, primary and billing contacts, seats used vs. limit. Call after lookup_customer_info if you need billing or seat context.

tools.name: check_system_status
tools.description: Check whether a Meridian platform system has an ongoing incident. Use to rule out an outage on our side before blaming the customer's configuration.

tools.name: spawn_specialist
tools.description: Hand one category of the ticket to a specialist agent (billing, technical, or account). The specialist has the deep tools, does the actual resolution work, and returns a writeup. Call once per category the ticket touches.

tools.name: write_response
tools.description: Send the final customer-facing reply and set the ticket status. Use "resolved" only if every issue the customer raised was actually fixed; "needs_info" if you need something from the customer; "escalated" after calling escalate_to_human.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Hand the ticket to a human engineer. Use for security issues, anything needing a code change, or any issue no specialist could resolve.
